command: ./scripts/check_docker_proxy.sh && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart docker && sg docker -c 'docker pull hello-world:latest'
success_condition: Docker Hub pull succeeds and systemctl shows a non-empty HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY environment for docker.service.
failure_policy: Do not continue to AHA or claim canonical L1 PASS until the user-owned sudo configuration is complete.
